blocks.text: LAS VEGAS — Talent has never been a question regarding the Aces as they have built the WNBA’s newest dynasty, but that alone doesn’t explain their success. Las Vegas has won three of the past four titles by also showing a mental toughness to overcome adversity, some of it the Aces’ own making and some foisted on them by events. And now the Aces find themselves in the familiar position of being one of the favorites to win the title, but face a number of challenges that could prevent them from making more history when the playoffs begin Sunday.
